fields.description: Open: anyone may create an account. Verified: unavailable; registration is blocked because email verification is not implemented. Use Open with administrator approval if needed. Disabled: the public sign-up form is turned off; owners are provisioned by an administrator or manager instead.
fields.label: Self sign-up mode

fields.description: When on, a self-signed-up account may create its own business through guided setup. When off, only invited/admin-provisioned accounts can create a business.
fields.label: Allow self-service business creation

fields.description: When on, a self-signed-up account is created disabled and waits for an administrator to approve it. Ignored when self sign-up is Disabled.
fields.label: Require administrator approval

fields.options: Guest booking is unaffected by these settings. Invited/admin provisioning (Team access) stays available unless it is turned off below.

fields.description: When on, a business manager may assign existing or new accounts through Team access. When off, only an Administrator may provision accounts.
fields.label: Allow manager invite/provisioning

fields.options: Invited/admin provisioning never sends real email in this environment; accounts are assigned locally.
